Release info

4th Of July - The Wild Session is a wonderful newly made box set released in 2021 with a collection of many of the outtakes from The Wild, The Innocent & The E Street Shuffle.
A truly beautiful compilation of Demo and Studios recordings recorded from January to September 1973 at 914 Sound Studio, Blauvelt, NY and Alpha Sound Studios, Richmond, VA (WGOE-AM Radio).
A box set, never released before, in a limited and numbered edition of 350 copies, containing 4 marbled grey vinyl records, a 4 page booklet and an insert bearing the same numbering as the box and the logo of the very famous label "The Godfatherecords".
